children: Conner Brown,
Executive Director at the
Bitcoin Policy Institute
, welcomed the House Financial Services Committee’s advancement of the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill on Wednesday.
‘Strategic National Asset’
Brown described the passage as a “genuinely historic step” for
Bitcoin
policy as it marked the first federal committee approval of legislation authorizing a secure storage facility for the U.S. government’s BTC holdings.
“ARMA [American Reserve Modernization Act] is common-sense policy: secure the Bitcoin America already owns and steward it as the strategic national asset it is,” he added.
A genuinely historic step for Bitcoin policy today.
For the first time, a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill was considered by a federal committee and it passed.

What Happens Next?
Rep.
Bryan Steil
(R-Wis.) strongly backed the bill, arguing that “fragmented and inconistent custody” of seized Bitcoin creates cybersecurity vulnerabilities and inadequate federal accounting.
The bill was “ordered to be reported favorably” by a 28-21 vote, which means it will be placed on the House legislative calendar.
It must still pass a floor vote in the House and the Senate and then be signed by President
Donald Trump
before it can become law.
